feature: Remote branches are deleted only when merged into a branch the remote keeps, one lease-guarded delete at a time
expected: Deletes only SAFE_CANDIDATE remote branches whose tip is an ancestor of the remote default or origin/<branch>.

Leaves PENDING_PUSH, KEPT_NOT_MERGED, STALE and protected branches alone; a branch merged only into the local <branch> is PUSH_THEN_DELETE while the publish is predicted to run, in the preview with or without --push, and is deleted only after --push has published <branch> in the same run (it becomes SAFE_CANDIDATE); without --push the apply leaves it and reports "kept: --push not typed"; it is PENDING_PUSH only when the publish is not predicted to run or was skipped, failed or unconfirmed.
Deletes with only the lease-guarded single-branch delete push and, only with --push, the one fast-forward push of <branch>; it never pushes other commits or tags and never force-pushes.

contains: git push --force-with-lease=refs/heads/<name>:<sha> <remote> :refs/heads/<name>
never push commits or tags except the one fast-forward push of `<branch>` that `--push` makes; never force-push
PENDING_PUSH
Each `PUSH_THEN_DELETE` candidate whose tip is an ancestor of that tip becomes `SAFE_CANDIDATE`; when the push was skipped, failed or unconfirmed, it is reported as `PENDING_PUSH` with that reason.
never run `git remote prune`, `git fetch --prune`, or `git branch -d -r`
never delete the remote default, `main`, the target's remote branch, a branch with a long-lived role
never delete a remote branch when phase 1 stopped
PUSH_THEN_DELETE     its tip is an ancestor of the converged target but not of any survivor, and the publish step is predicted to run
without `--push` the apply leaves it and reports "kept: --push not typed"
A `PUSH_THEN_DELETE` branch is listed with its two ways forward
Phase 2 is `UNKNOWN` when the live `HEAD` names a branch other than the remote default, when a survivor's live tip differs from its remote-tracking SHA, or when a survivor is missing.
disable-model-invocation: true
guarded by `--force-with-lease` on its recorded SHA
Never push other commits or tags, never force-push
A remote branch is deleted only when its tip is already contained in the remote's own copy of `<branch>` or its default branch.
`PENDING_PUSH`
(rerun with `--push`, or push `<branch>` yourself and run `/GitSweep` again)
Stop on a conflict and delete nothing, locally or remotely.

A branch merged only into the local `<branch>` is `PUSH_THEN_DELETE` while the push is predicted to run, in the preview with or without `--push`: with `--push` the run publishes `<branch>` first and then deletes it, and without `--push` the run leaves it on the remote and reports "kept: `--push` not typed" (rerun with `--push`, or push `<branch>` yourself and run `/GitSweep` again).

It is `PENDING_PUSH` when the push is not predicted to run (for example `<branch>` is the remote default, or the remote's `<branch>` is not an ancestor of the local one) or when the run skipped the push, or the push failed or was not confirmed: clear the condition the report names, then rerun (with `--push`, except when `<branch>` is the remote default, which the command never pushes).
